value_case.statement: Optional bounded dimension-aware averaged colored-light transport through portals, plus shader tint correction.
acceptance: Experimental portal colored lighting is disabled by default and independent of experimental shared sunlight.
Colored source changes and removal update dimension-agnostic portal illumination without requiring aperture visibility or feeding imported light back.
Unknown/unloaded/unsupported mod data remains bounded with documented fallback.
Shader-on and shader-off visual checks, performance bounds, optional-mod absence and settings restoration are verified separately.
Investigate and correct reported shader portal tint with source-grounded rendering tests.
